# Assessments

The course is letter graded. Four things are graded.

| Component | What it means | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly update emails | Twelve updates to the person you report to, CC strategy-program@byu.edu. VPs Friday, presidencies Monday. See [Weekly Updates](03-weekly-updates.qmd). | 50% |
| Attendance | Be in the room. Thirteen sessions, one free absence. | 25% |
| Feedback conversation | One conversation with your leader at the end of the semester, plus a short reflection. See [Feedback Conversations](04-peer-feedback.qmd). | 10% |
| Discussant | Pick a company or leader, share a short pre-read, and lead a 15 minute discussion once. See [Being a Discussant](05-discussant.qmd). | 15% |

Nothing in this course is graded on hours worked. Every component is available in full to an
unpaid volunteer VP and a paid employee alike, by design. See Credit and Pay in the
[syllabus](index.qmd).

## Weekly Update Emails

Twelve updates each, sent to the person directly above you in the program, with
`strategy-program@byu.edu` in CC. The CC is how completion is tracked, so an update without
it does not count.

Two deadlines, because the updates cascade. VPs write first so their co-presidents have
something to roll up.

| You are | Full credit | Half credit through | No credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| VPs | Fri, 11:59 PM | Mon, 11:59 PM | After Monday |
| Presidencies | Mon, 11:59 PM | Wed, 11:59 PM | After Wednesday |

Nothing here requires working on a Saturday or a Sunday. The reporting table, format, and an
example are on the [Weekly Updates](03-weekly-updates.qmd) page.

## Feedback Conversation

One conversation at the end of the semester. You meet with the person you report to, both of
you give feedback, and each of you submits a short reflection afterward.

| Conversation held | Reflection due |
|---|---|
| Nov 17 to Dec 4 | Fri, Dec 4, 11:59 PM |

The reflection is what is graded, not the feedback. Nothing anyone says about you affects
your grade. Details are on the [Feedback Conversations](04-peer-feedback.qmd) page.

## Attendance

Thirteen sessions.

**Everyone gets one free absence, no questions asked.** Do not email anyone about it, do not
explain it, do not apologize for it. It is yours to spend on whatever the semester throws at
you: an interview, an illness, a family thing, a week that got away from you.

After that, absences count.

| Sessions missed | Attendance credit |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | Full |
| 2 | 12 of 13 |
| 3 | 11 of 13 |
| and so on | one session per absence |

Each absence past the first costs about two points of your final grade.

Two things the free absence does not cover. It does not excuse that week's update, which is
sent by email and does not require you to be in the room. And if you miss the session you are
signed up to lead as discussant, arrange a swap with someone in advance rather than spending
the free absence on it.

## Discussant

Once during the semester you and up to two classmates pick a company or leader, put a link
to a short pre-read in the sign-up sheet by Tuesday 11:59 PM, and lead a 15 minute
discussion that Friday. Details and grading are on the
[Being a Discussant](05-discussant.qmd) page.

There is no separate AI assessment. AI proficiency is built and demonstrated in the weekly
drills, which is why the paid subscription is required. See Required Tools in the
[syllabus](index.qmd).

## Credit and Pay

Because student employees are paid for their leadership work, class sessions and
class-specific assignments are not billable hours. Keep the two separate on your timesheet.
